freeze_boundary: Committed before target extraction or analysis of actual coarse full-runtime outcomes. No cut output determines target geometry, alignment, parameters or thresholds.
motivation: Prior independent uncut H2 flatbar control fails the analytic-plane gouge bound at sharp outer corners. This distinct represented-solid goal retains all footprint columns and the original analytic-plane result separately.

measurement.missing_semantics: No vertical solid intersection means an empty column of height0. Both-empty columns have zero represented-solid height difference but remain counted in each and union missing fractions. A one-sided actual gap incurs the full represented-target column deficit; target-empty actual-filled columns incur positive residual. No column is dropped or imputed with ideal depth.
measurement.error: actual represented height minus fixed target represented height on ALL4800 columns

synthetic_controls.exact_target: Same target heights/validity, all errors0; missing columns remain counted

additional_physical_acceptance: Existing finite positive-Jacobian, actual runtime, force, camera, reset and contact acceptance remain separate and cannot be inferred from this geometry metric.
promotion_boundary: New represented-solid shape version only. Combined task goal requires ALL listed physical topology/removal/mass/history/provenance checks AND represented-shape limits. Original v1 analytic-plane failures remain unchanged; geometry alone never certifies physical cutting or full simulation.
